## Purpose

State the smallest theory, Skill, runtime, evaluation, or documentation problem this closes.

## Evidence and scope

- Evidence, counterexample, or reproduction:
- Explicitly out of scope:
- Claim type: definition / hypothesis / implementation / empirical result

## Validation

List the commands run and results. Explain any effect on the field contract, center, necessary order, closure, residuals, or version lineage.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is necessary for use, understanding, validation, or maintenance.
- [ ] I did not turn a software test into philosophical or empirical proof.
- [ ] I preserved old evidence and version lineage when meaning changed.
- [ ] I removed private data and unrelated files.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material under CC BY-NC 4.0.
